predictions.claim: SpaceX will price its IPO at around $1.8 trillion, going public next month.
predictions.speaker: Benedikt Kammel
predictions.notes: Musk publicly called the lower figure 'false'; pricing expected within days.

predictions.claim: Both Anthropic and OpenAI could IPO as soon as this fall, with this likely Anthropic's final private round.
predictions.speaker: Shereen Ghaffary / Rebecca Torrence
predictions.notes: Anthropic's IPO timeline reportedly unchanged by the $65B raise.

predictions.claim: About 25% of US economy tasks could be automated, raising trend real GDP growth to 2.4% over the next 10 years, with more jobs created than lost.
predictions.speaker: Matthew Weir (Goldman Sachs)
predictions.notes: Gradual transition thesis; painful at the individual/sector level.

predictions.claim: AI will cause a net 15% displacement of knowledge workers, possibly within three years.
predictions.speaker: Carson Block (Muddy Waters)
predictions.notes: Directly contradicts Goldman's optimistic net-jobs view.

predictions.claim: Memory will remain the AI bottleneck for at least the next two years.
predictions.speaker: Janet Mui (RBC Brewin Dolphin)
predictions.notes: Underpins bullish thesis on Micron and SK Hynix.

predictions.claim: The New Glenn explosion will cause significant delays across Blue Origin's launch schedule, satellite backlog, and the NASA Artemis lunar lander timeline.
predictions.speaker: Loren Grush
predictions.notes: Launch-pad infrastructure damage compounds the rocket rebuild; SpaceX is NASA's fallback lander.

predictions.claim: The AI capex cycle is sustainable only if enterprise users start generating profits; otherwise semiconductor valuations and AI private companies face vulnerability.
predictions.speaker: Matthew Weir (Goldman Sachs)
predictions.notes: Currently only chip companies profit from the AI stack.
